bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 100L
	w = rep(c(0, 1), each = n / 2L)
	T_ev = stats::rexp(n, rate = 0.1 * exp(-0.3 * w))
	L = numeric(n); R = numeric(n)
	for (i in seq_len(n)) {
		visits = cumsum(stats::runif(8L, 1, 4))
		before = visits[visits < T_ev[i]]
		after = visits[visits >= T_ev[i]]
		L[i] = if (length(before)) max(before) else 0
		R[i] = if (length(after)) min(after) else Inf
	}
	w_draws = lapply(seq_len(10L), function(b) sample(w))
	list(L = L, R = R, w = w, w_draws = w_draws)
}
notes: Times 10 randomization draws (permuted w) of the interval-censored log-rank estimate at n=100, as the generic rand loop re-dispatches compute_shared_icen (log_rank.R:254-261) per draw; the candidate fits the pooled NPMLE once and passes icFIT=. ictest.R:104 calls icfit(L, R, NULL, icfitControl(), NULL, NULL), identical to the candidate's interval::icfit(L, R), so the estimates should agree bit for bit; at n=100 methodRuleIC1 already picks pclt, so the gain measured here is the skipped NPMLE solves only (the exact-p saving applies at n<=20).
